reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound for the described CoCrFeNiMo system, with well-established mechanisms (solid-solution strengthening, second-phase hardening, tribofilm lubrication) and consistent predicted outcomes, though it is entirely off-topic for the AlCrFeNiSi additive manufacturing question.
reasons.testability: The proposed falsification test is clear and decisive, specifying measurements (XRD, SEM/EDS, hardness, compression, tribology, Raman) and a clear criterion (predicted outcome not observed), making it highly testable.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is completely irrelevant to the research question about AlCrFeNiSi powder for additive manufacturing, addressing a different material system, processing method, and property set, so it offers no useful guidance.
